name: whole_horizon_corridor_v1
cohort: existing frozen expansion 24; previously exposed development cases
inputs: Current learned rectangles, learned nominal trajectory, Astra oriented windows, online visual boundary and object predictions, navigation and causal CAN only. No future ego, annotations or evaluation scores.
geometry: All six 0.5s rectangles solved as bounded whole-horizon least squares on center, modulo-pi longitudinal axis and short axis width. Anchor changes to original. No disjoint region union. Preserve long sides. Short side additions <=1.85 m. Mathematical trial rectangles are independently clipped against predicted road and objects at every knot.
guidance: Move nominal BODY reference minimally toward the nearest point inside each oriented window. Smooth the six-knot displacement with start anchor and separate first/second differences. Window angle specifies region axes, not forced vehicle yaw.
dynamics: 12 x 0.25s bicycle controls; original control/steering/slew limits and nonnegative speed retained; longitudinal jerk <=5 m/s^3 between observed controls; |v^2*tan(delta)/L| <=3 m/s^2 at both ends of every constant-control interval; controls and reference smoothing also penalized in objective.
selection: Try archived native if it already meets physical, task, continuous predicted road/object and additional smoothness limits. Else original-size fixed corridor, global corrected corridor, then optional closest-window with <=1m position miss and HARD original speed bounds. Keep canonical diagnostic fixed clearance floor. No GT-ranking, no automatic unsafe fallback. Stop at first exact eligible result. Missing causal steering remains unknown.
metrics: Report no-output denominator, matched-pair recorded collision, ADE/FDE, longitudinal jerk and lateral acceleration. No safety/generalization claims. No clearance weakening.
